title.en: Building Maintenance and Strata Management (Lift, Escalator and Building Maintenance) (Revocation) Regulations 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Building Maintenance and Strata Management (Lift, Escalator and Building Maintenance) (Revocation) Regulations 2025 and come into operation on 1 October 2025.
2. Revoke the Building Maintenance and Strata Management (Lift, Escalator and Building Maintenance) Regulations 2016 (G.N. No. S 348/2016) (called in these Regulations the revoked Regulations).

3.—(1) Despite regulation 2, regulations 14 and 14A of the revoked Regulations continue to apply to any incident involving any lift or part of a lift that occurs before 1 October 2025.
(2) Despite regulation 2, regulations 26 and 26A of the revoked Regulations continue to apply to any incident involving any escalator or part of an escalator that occurs before 1 October 2025.
(3) Despite regulation 2, regulations 7 and 17 of the revoked Regulations continue to apply to any major alteration or replacement works on a lift that commence before 1 October 2025.
(4) Despite regulation 2, regulations 19 and 29 of the revoked Regulations continue to apply to any major alteration or replacement works on an escalator that commence before 1 October 2025.
